content: Your current medical condition should be closely monitored while using this medication. Laboratory tests, such as those assessing kidney function, should be conducted as recommended by your healthcare provider. It is essential to attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose of this medication, it is crucial to contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately to receive guidance on a new dosing schedule. Do not attempt to adjust the schedule on your own. For proper storage of this medication, refer to the product instructions or consult your pharmacist. Medications should not be flushed down the toilet or poured into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. When the medication is expired or no longer needed, dispose of it properly according to the guidelines provided by your pharmacist or local waste disposal authority. The information provided here is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the medication is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific condition. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete and individualized guidance regarding this medication and your health needs. If you are comparing formulary information for medications, you may need to create a list of plans to view and compare the status of drugs within the same class. This list can be saved and edited as needed. Keep in mind that formulary details may vary between plans and are subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider directly.
